core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gibran corresponds to the Arabic form جبران (Arabic root ج ب ر (j-b-r); جبران (Jibrān / Jubrān)). Its core sense is mending, healing, strength. Gibran is Arabic جبران (Jibrān / Jubrān), from the root ج ب ر (j-b-r) 'to mend, set right, restore; to be strong' — hence 'mending, healing, strength'. It is the name made famous in the West by the poet Kahlil Gibran. The source gloss 'powerful, generous' captures the 'strength' element but drops the primary 'mending/healing' sense.
